beats.say: Hrithik Roshan turns up in Jailer 2, as someone called Roddy.
And he's not alone. Mohanlal is back as Mathew, Shiva Rajkumar as Narasimha, and Jackie Shroff arrives as Kamdev.
At the centre, Rajinikanth returns as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian.
Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu and Mirnaa reprise their roles, and S. J. Suryah joins as Bodhi Kalpak.
Vidya Balan and Mithun Chakraborty are new to the cast too.
Nelson Dilipkumar wrote and directed it, and it opened worldwide on 15 October.
